id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description: The specification used for retrieving data displayed by the tab panel.

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

texts.description: Holds text information for the tab panel, including title, sub-title, and body text.

title.description: Static title for the tab panel.

subTitle.description: Static sub-title for the tab panel.

bodyText.description: Static body text for the tab panel.

bodyParagraph.description: Body paragraph that has a set of label-value objects than will appear in the tab panel.

tabBarStyle.description: The visual look of the tab bar

tabComponents.description:
Configurations of components to be rendered as child tabs.
Id is required, title is optional.

tileComponents.description:
Configurations of components to be rendered as tiles in the title section.
Id is required.

tabs.description:
Props derived from tabComponents for the presentational React component.
It has an id and a title.

tabsWithNotification.description: The ids of tabs with notifications.

tiles.description:
Props derived from tileComponents for the presentational React component.
It has an id and a title.

activeTab.description: The id of the active tab.

primaryActionButtonTitle.description: The text to render on the primary action button.

secondaryActionButtonTitle.description: The text to render on the secondary action button.

primaryActionButtonLoading.description: Whether the primary action button is in the loading state.

secondaryActionButtonLoading.description: Whether the secondary action button is in the loading state.

primaryActionButtonDisabled.description: Whether the primary action button is disabled.

secondaryActionButtonDisabled.description: Whether the secondary action button is disabled.

iconActions.description: The icon action configs to render in the tab panel title section.

tertiaryAction.description:
Whether or not to render the tertiary action button.  On click {@link clickActionButton} will be fired and submit a
`TERTIARY_ACTION_CLICK` action.

title: Wrapper around the {@link UiSdlTabPanel} type to filter out component ref props.
name: UiConfigTabPanel
